patch_description:
Replace the clipped ring layout and greedy, order-dependent radius computation with a deterministic nonlinear constructor. The new constructor starts from several staggered hexagonal/layered seeds, then uses SLSQP to optimize all 26 centers and radii simultaneously. Its constraints directly encode containment in the unit square and every pairwise non-overlap condition.

This is substantially stronger than computing radii greedily after choosing centers: the previous pair loop can unnecessarily shrink earlier circles and cannot trade radius between circles. The staggered rows provide a useful dense initial contact graph, while multiple small deterministic perturbations allow the optimizer to break symmetry and exploit boundary effects and unequal radii. A final uniform certification scale protects against floating-point constraint tolerances, so the returned packing remains valid.
